{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Jaar. Sweetened alcoari milk and vineberry extract. It's too sweet for my taste, but you might like it.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Jarik Solo]]|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
A '''vineberry''' was a fruit native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was often served fermented and used with [[alcoari milk]] to make [[jaar]].
